info.title: OSPF_Interface
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

bdr.description: OSPFv2 Router Interface IP or OSPFv3 Router ID of the Backup Designated Router. The Router ID is in IPv4 address format.

calculated_output_cost.description: The calculated output cost of OSPF interface, based on the interface bandwidth and reference bandwidth.

dr.description: OSPFv2 Router Interface IP or OSPFv3 Router ID of the Designated Router. The Router ID is in IPv4 address format.

ifsm_state.description: OSPF Interface FSM states. The default value is "depend_upon".

instance_id.description: Instance ID coresponding to the OSPFv3 Interface. IPv6 unicast ranges from 0-31 and and IPv4 unicast  ranges from 64-95.

interface_name.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Interface](#/OSPF_Interface)
The list of all the "OSPF_Interface" for the OSPF Area, which contains the OSPF interface related configurations, statuses, and statistics.

ipsec_ah_sas.description:
Reference Resource: [IPsec_SA](#/IPsec_SA)
List of IPsec Authentication Header (AH) Security Associations (SA). Generally, two SAs are referenced for well known OSPF multicast addresses and remaining for unicast addresses. One unicast SA will use interface ip address as `dest_ip` for incoming packets and others will use OSPF neighbor ip addresses as `dest_ip` for outgoing packets.

ipsec_esp_sas.description:
Reference Resource: [IPsec_SA](#/IPsec_SA)
List of IPsec Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) SAs. Generally, two SAs are referenced for well known OSPF multicast addresses and remaining for unicast addresses. One unicast SA will use interface ip address as `dest_ip` for incoming packets and others will use OSPF neighbor ip addresses as `dest_ip` for outgoing packets.

ipsec_sps.description:
Reference Resource: [IPsec_SP](#/IPsec_SP)
List of IPsec Security Policies (SP). Generally, two SPs are referenced for well known OSPF multicast addresses and two SPs for each unicast addresses. One unicast SP will use interface ip address as `src_prefix` for outgoing packets and the other will use interface ip address as `dest_prefix` for incoming packets.

port.description:

rcvd_area_mismatch.description: Number of OSPF packet header 'area mismatch' errors detected on this interface.

rcvd_auth_errors.description: Number of received OSPF packets that failed authentication checks.

rcvd_auth_fail.description: Number of OSPF packets received on this interface that were dropped because their authentication failed.

rcvd_auth_mismatch.description: Number of OSPF packets received on this interface that were dropped because their authentication type did not match the configured type in the receiving interface.

rcvd_bad_dd_desc_pkt.description: Number of invalid OSPF Database Description packets received on this interface.

rcvd_bad_hello.description: Number of received Hello packets that failed verification.

rcvd_bad_lsa_checksum.description: Number of received LSAs ignored because of invalid LSA checksum.

rcvd_bad_lsa_data.description: Number of received LSAs ignored because of invalid LSA data.

rcvd_bad_lsa_length.description: Number of received LSAs ignored because of bad LSA length.

rcvd_bad_lsa_type.description: Number of received LSAs ignored because of bad LSA type.

rcvd_bad_lsu_length.description: Number of received LSU packets dropped because they contained an LSA with bad LSA length.

rcvd_bad_source.description: Number of OSPF packet header 'bad source' errors detected on this interface.

rcvd_bad_unknown.description: Number of received OSPF packets that were dropped for a reason not defined in these statistics.

rcvd_dead_mismatch.description: Number of received Hello packets that were dropped because their dead-interval did not match the configured interval in the receiving interface.

rcvd_dupe_id.description: Number of OSPF packet header 'duplicate id' errors detected on this interface. This count is incremented when the router id in a received OSPF packet header matches the local router id.

rcvd_hello_mismatch.description: Number of received Hello packets that were dropped because their hello-interval did not match the configured interval in the receiving interface.

rcvd_if_standby.description: Number of received OSPF packets dropped because the interface is in standby state.

rcvd_inst_id_mismatch.description: Number of received instant packets that were dropped because their instance-id did not match the configured instance-id on the receiving interface.

rcvd_invalid_checksum.description: Number of OSPF packet header checksum errors detected on this interface.

rcvd_invalid_length.description: Number of OSPF packet header length errors detected on this interface.

rcvd_invalid_type.description: Number of OSPF packets with an invalid type field received on this interface.

rcvd_invalid_version.description: Number of OSPF packet header version errors detected on this interface.

rcvd_mask_mismatch.description: Number of received Hello packets that were dropped because their netmask did not match the configured mask in the receiving interface.

rcvd_mtu_mismatch.description: Number of received Database Description packets whose MTU field does not match local configuration.

rcvd_nbr_ignored.description: Number of received Hello packets that were ignored based on the identity of the sending neighbor.

rcvd_options_mismatch.description: Number of received Hello packets that were dropped because their optional capabilities did not match the configured options in the receiving interface.

rcvd_resource_fail.description: Number of received OSPF packets dropped because of resource failure.

rcvd_self_originated.description: Number of OSPF packet header 'self-originated' errors detected on this interface. This count is incremented when the source IP address of a received OSPF packet is a local IP address.

rcvd_wrong_protocol.description: Number of received OSPF packets with wrong IP protocol field.

rx_discard.description: The total number of  received packets discarded on the interface.

sent_failed.description: Number of packets that OSPF could not send on this interface.

state_changes.description: The total number of state changes on the interface.

statistics_clear_performed.description: Number of times the statistics for this OSPF interface have been cleared.

statistics_clear_requested.description: Number of times a request was made to clear the statistics for this OSPF interface.

active.description: Updates status whether the interface is active. The default value is true.

statistics_reset_time.description: Time when statistics were last reset in seconds since the Unix epoch.

hello_sent.description: The total number of hello packets sent on the interface.

hello_sent_byte.description: Number of bytes sent in OSPF Hello packets on this interface.

ls_ack_rcvd.description: The total number of Link State Ack packets received on the interface.

ls_ack_rcvd_byte.description: Number of bytes received in OSPF LS Acknowledgement packets on this interface.

ls_ack_sent.description: The total number of Link State Ack packets sent on the interface.

ls_ack_sent_byte.description: Number of bytes sent in OSPF LS Acknowledgement packets on this interface.

ls_req_rcvd.description: The total number of Link State Request packets received on the interface.

ls_req_rcvd_byte.description: Number of bytes received in OSPF LS Request packets on this interface.

ls_req_sent.description: The total number of Link State Request packets sent on the interface.

ls_req_sent_byte.description: Number of bytes sent in OSPF LS Request packets on this interface.

ls_upd_rcvd.description: The total number of Link State Update packets received on the interface.

ls_upd_rcvd_byte.description: Number of bytes received in OSPF LS Update packets on this interface.

ls_upd_sent.description: The total number of Link State Update packets sent on the interface.

ls_upd_sent_byte.description: Number of bytes sent in OSPF LS Update packets on this interface.

lsa_checksum_sum.description: The 32-bit unsigned sum of the link-state advertisements' LS checksums contained in this interface's link-local link state database.

lsa_count.description: Total number of link-local link state advertisements in this interface's link- local link state database.

rcvd_area_mismatch.description: Number of OSPF packet header 'area mismatch' errors detected on this interface.

rcvd_auth_errors.description: Number of received OSPF packets that failed authentication checks.

rcvd_auth_fail.description: Number of OSPF packets received on this interface that were dropped because their authentication failed.

rcvd_auth_mismatch.description: Number of OSPF packets received on this interface that were dropped because their authentication type did not match the configured type in the receiving interface.

rcvd_bad_dd_desc_pkt.description: Number of invalid OSPF Database Description packets received on this interface.

rcvd_bad_hello.description: Number of received Hello packets that failed verification.

rcvd_bad_lsa_checksum.description: Number of received LSAs ignored because of invalid LSA checksum.

rcvd_bad_lsa_data.description: Number of received LSAs ignored because of invalid LSA data.

rcvd_bad_lsa_length.description: Number of received LSAs ignored because of bad LSA length.

rcvd_bad_lsa_type.description: Number of received LSAs ignored because of bad LSA type.

rcvd_bad_lsu_length.description: Number of received LSU packets dropped because they contained an LSA with bad LSA length.

rcvd_bad_source.description: Number of OSPF packet header 'bad source' errors detected on this interface.

rcvd_bad_unknown.description: Number of received OSPF packets that were dropped for a reason not defined in these statistics.

rcvd_dead_mismatch.description: Number of received Hello packets that were dropped because their dead-interval did not match the configured interval in the receiving interface.

rcvd_dupe_id.description: Number of OSPF packet header 'duplicate id' errors detected on this interface. This count is incremented when the router id in a received OSPF packet header matches the local router id.

rcvd_hello_mismatch.description: Number of received Hello packets that were dropped because their hello-interval did not match the configured interval in the receiving interface.

rcvd_if_standby.description: Number of received OSPF packets dropped because the interface is in standby state.

rcvd_inst_id_mismatch.description: Number of received instant packets that were dropped because their instance-id did not match the configured instance-id on the receiving interface.

rcvd_invalid_checksum.description: Number of OSPF packet header checksum errors detected on this interface.

rcvd_invalid_length.description: Number of OSPF packet header length errors detected on this interface.

rcvd_invalid_type.description: Number of OSPF packets with an invalid type field received on this interface.

rcvd_invalid_version.description: Number of OSPF packet header version errors detected on this interface.

rcvd_mask_mismatch.description: Number of received Hello packets that were dropped because their netmask did not match the configured mask in the receiving interface.

rcvd_mtu_mismatch.description: Number of received Database Description packets whose MTU field does not match local configuration.

rcvd_nbr_ignored.description: Number of received Hello packets that were ignored based on the identity of the sending neighbor.

rcvd_options_mismatch.description: Number of received Hello packets that were dropped because their optional capabilities did not match the configured options in the receiving interface.

rcvd_resource_fail.description: Number of received OSPF packets dropped because of resource failure.

rcvd_self_originated.description: Number of OSPF packet header 'self-originated' errors detected on this interface. This count is incremented when the source IP address of a received OSPF packet is a local IP address.

rcvd_wrong_protocol.description: Number of received OSPF packets with wrong IP protocol field.

rx_discard.description: The total number of  received packets discarded on the interface.

sent_failed.description: Number of packets that OSPF could not send on this interface.

state_changes.description: The total number of state changes on the interface.

statistics_clear_performed.description: Number of times the statistics for this OSPF interface have been cleared.

statistics_clear_requested.description: Number of times a request was made to clear the statistics for this OSPF interface.

active.description: Updates status whether the interface is active. The default value is true.

statistics_reset_time.description: Time when statistics were last reset in seconds since the Unix epoch.

parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Area](#/OSPF_Area)
The list of all the "OSPF_Area" for the OSPF router instance, which contains the OSPFv2 area related configurations. The Area ID is in IPv4 address format.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)

interface_name.description:

port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The "Port" corresponding to the OSPF Interface. If not set, OSPF is not operational on that port.
